name: Paloma
description: Tequila and grapefruit soda with a squeeze of lime—Mexico’s essential highball.
history: Widely enjoyed across Mexico as a simple tequila highball. Grapefruit soda (not juice alone) is the traditional lengthener.
whyItWorks: Grapefruit bitterness and bubbles flatter agave; lime sharpens the finish. A salt rim echoes the Margarita without copying it.
steps: Salt the rim if desired and fill a highball with ice.
Top with grapefruit soda and stir gently once.
techniqueNotes: If grapefruit soda is out, use fresh grapefruit juice plus club soda and a touch of simple syrup—an approximation, not the classic.
Tajín on the rim is a welcome spicy alternative to salt.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Smooth enough for a long highball without disappearing.
Everyday tequila for an easy Paloma.

substitutions.notes: Club soda + grapefruit juice + simple approximates when soda is unavailable.
